purpose: Desktop research only: open-weight image denoisers,not textual LLMs. No checkpoint downloaded,installed or run;no user image uploaded.
size_convention: FP32 bytes=4*parameter_count,decimal MB=bytes/1000000. Inferred raw tensor storage,not actual checkpoint/archive size or runtime memory.

models.name: IRCNN color,one7layer network
models.count_method: Analytical count of KAIR IRCNN(in_nc=3,out_nc=3,nc=64):two RGB boundary convolutions and five64to64 convolutions,3x3,with biases.
models.scope: Historical Gaussian-noise baseline. Author evaluation selects one of25noise-level checkpoints;one network is not the entire bank.

models.name: FFDNet gray
models.count_method: Analytical count of KAIR FFDNet(in_nc=1,out_nc=1,nc=64,nb=15,act_mode=R),convolution weights and biases. No batchnorm in this deployment variant.
models.scope: Grayscale,known/estimated noise map. Not RGB camera-noise validation.

models.name: FFDNet color
models.count_method: Analytical count of author KAIR deployment configuration:nc96,nb12,13unshuffledinput channels,12output channels,3x3convs and biases.
models.scope: RGB Gaussian-noise model conditioned by noise level. Official pretrained color/gray and clipped variants listed in author evaluation.

models.name: NAFNet SIDD width32
models.count_method: Analytical count from official config enc[2,2,4,8],middle12,dec[2,2,2,2],width32,RGB. Each NAFBlock(c) has7c^2+33c trainable scalars with default expansion2;add intro/ending/down/up convolutions. Not measured by loading a checkpoint.
models.scope: Published RGB real-image SIDD checkpoint;smartphone data not Canon post-RCD Rec2020 validation. Different depths at same width have different counts.

models.name: Restormer,standard reference scale
models.count_method: Paper table8 reports26.12M for refinement variant;order of magnitude only,exact checkpoint/task config must be counted separately.
models.scope: Image-restoration transformer,not language model. Author repository exposes Gaussian and real-image denoising weights.

memory_example.meaning: One activation tensor only;additional layers,skip features,workspaces,image buffers and runtime increase memory.

minimum_conclusion: No universal minimum size for quality. Existing historical denoisers demonstrate roughly0.2to1Mparameters can perform Gaussian denoising;not a guarantee for CanonRAW or modern quality. Few-tens-of-millions models are practical comparison candidates,not billions-parameterLLMs.
ipr_domain_warning: Current linearRec2020 master is unbounded,can have negative or>1values and correlated/demosaic-dependentnoise. Do not blindly feed or clip to RGB[0,1] checkpoints. Need explicit domain/noise adaptation and held-out validation. No neural integration authorized by this research.
limitations: Selective source-verified landscape,not exhaustive market survey or performance ranking. No inference latency/RAM/quality measured onIPRhardware. Parameter counts inferred from specific author implementations,not downloaded model file inspection. No guarantee of sub10second fullframe inference.
